segments.en: Hello everyone and welcome back to EnglishPod.
segments.zh: 大家好，欢迎回到 EnglishPod。

segments.en: My name is Marco.
segments.zh: 我叫 Marco。

segments.en: My name is Catherine and today we have a very special lesson for everyone.
segments.zh: 我的名字是凯瑟琳，今天我们为每个人提供了一个非常特别的课程。

segments.en: It's a new level for us.
segments.zh: 这对我们来说是一个新的层次。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: It's an advanced media lesson and we are going to be listening to an apology.
segments.zh: 这是一个高级媒体课程，我们将听取道歉。

segments.en: Well, it's an apology letter but we're going to actually have someone talk it out.
segments.zh: 好吧，这是一封道歉信，但我们实际上会有人说出来。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So, what's happening here is someone is reading a letter they've written and they're trying to apologize for something and we don't really know what this something is but I want everyone to really listen here to the words that are being used and to the ways in which we can say sorry because as they say, there are a thousand ways to say I'm sorry.
segments.zh: 所以，这里发生的事情是有人正在阅读他们写的一封信，他们正试图为某事道歉，但我们并不真正知道这是什么，但我希望每个人都真正听这里正在使用的单词以及我们可以说对不起的方式，因为他们说的是，那里 有一千种方式说我很抱歉。

segments.en: Dear Mary, I come here today this way because I need to apologize to you.
segments.zh: 亲爱的玛丽，我今天是这样来到这里的，因为我需要向你道歉。

segments.en: I failed you.
segments.zh: 我让你失望了。

segments.en: Although I did not lie to you in words, I lied to you with faces that did not belong to me.
segments.zh: 虽然我没有用语言骗你，但我用不属于我的面孔骗了你。

segments.en: I never meant to ruin the friendship that meant the world to me.
segments.zh: 我从没想过要毁掉这段对我无比重要的友谊。

segments.en: You mean the world to me and now I come to you asking for forgiveness.
segments.zh: 你对我来说就是整个世界，现在我来请求你的原谅。

segments.en: If in your heart you find you can't, then I will understand and learn from this experience.
segments.zh: 如果在你的心中你发现你不能，那么我会理解并从这次经历中学习。

segments.en: You came into my life at a time when I needed you the most.
segments.zh: 在我最需要你的时候，你进入了我的生活。

segments.en: We talked about so many things that I started to realize my heart and my soul could actually feel something other than hurt.
segments.zh: 我们谈到了很多事情，我开始意识到我的心，我的灵魂实际上可以感觉到伤害以外的东西。

segments.en: You placed comfort where there was fear, confidence when there was doubt, a shoulder where tears could fall and completeness where there was emptiness.
segments.zh: 在我恐惧时，你给予安慰；在我怀疑时，你给予信心；在我流泪时，你给我依靠的肩膀；在我空虚时，你让我的心重新完整。

segments.en: I wanted to hold on to this so badly that I did whatever it took for you to notice.
segments.zh: 我太想留住这一切，所以想尽办法让你注意到我。

segments.en: What I didn't realize was that I could lose my entire being, all of who I was and all of that I had placed in you.
segments.zh: 我却没意识到，这可能让我失去自我，失去真实的自己，也失去寄托在你身上的一切。

segments.en: I wanted to be the one who would be there when you needed to talk.
segments.zh: 当你需要谈话时，我想成为那个会在那里的人。

segments.en: I wanted to be the comfort for your soul when the world was too much to handle.
segments.zh: 当生活让你难以承受时，我想成为你心灵的慰藉。

segments.en: I wanted to be strong for you when everything else seemed impossible.
segments.zh: 当其他一切似乎都不可能时，我想为你坚强。

segments.en: I wanted to love you in only the way you deserve to be loved, never realizing that I was destroying myself and you.
segments.zh: 我只想以你应该被爱的方式爱你，从来没有意识到我正在摧毁自己和你。

segments.en: Somehow I needed you to be a part of my life.
segments.zh: 不知何故，我需要你成为我生活的一部分。

segments.en: The only problem was that I was willing to jeopardize everything to get that done.
segments.zh: 唯一的问题是，为了让你留在我生命里，我愿意拿一切去冒险。

segments.en: All the things that I told you about how I felt and how you make me feel were true.
segments.zh: 我告诉你的所有关于我的感受以及你让我感觉如何的事情都是真实的。

segments.en: Nothing else mattered to me except hearing the laughter in your voice when you were happy.
segments.zh: 除了听到你开心时的笑声，其他一切对我都不重要。

segments.en: You made my days easy to get through and my nights peaceful.
segments.zh: 你让我的日子很容易度过，我的夜晚很平静。

segments.en: You helped me look forward to another day.
segments.zh: 你帮助我期待了另一天。

segments.en: Even though distance separated us, just being was enough.
segments.zh: 尽管我们相隔遥远，只要有这份陪伴就已足够。

segments.en: I'm sorry for hurting you and if I had to do it all over again, I would have been 100% with you.
segments.zh: 对不起，我伤害了你。如果能重新来过，我一定会对你百分之百坦诚。

segments.en: Forgive me please.
segments.zh: 请原谅我。

segments.en: All right, we're back.
segments.zh: 好了，我们回来了。

segments.en: So the guy seemed to be pretty sad.
segments.zh: 所以这家伙似乎很伤心。

segments.en: Yeah, this is a very intense.
segments.zh: 是的，这是一个非常激烈的。

segments.en: Well, it's not a dialogue.
segments.zh: 好吧，这不是对话。

segments.en: It's a monologue.
segments.zh: 这是一个独白。

segments.en: One person is reading it.
segments.zh: 一个人正在阅读它。

segments.en: So it's a very intense monologue.
segments.zh: 所以这是一个非常激烈的独白。

segments.en: Very romantic.
segments.zh: 真浪漫。

segments.en: Yeah, romantic, but also an air of melancholy.
segments.zh: 是的，浪漫，但也有一种忧郁的气息。

segments.en: Yeah, that's true.
segments.zh: 对，确实如此。

segments.en: He's kind of like apologizing and at the same time expressing love and all these feelings.
segments.zh: 他有点像道歉，同时表达爱和所有这些感受。

segments.en: So it was very interesting.
segments.zh: 所以这很有趣。

segments.en: But why don't we take a look at a couple of phrases.
segments.zh: 但是我们为什么不看看几个短语。

segments.en: Now in advanced media, we're not going to analyze the entire dialogue or as we do in the other levels, actually pick out items for language takeaway or fluency builder.
segments.zh: 现在在高级媒体中，我们不会分析整个对话，或者像在其他级别那样，实际上挑选出语言外卖或流畅性构建器的项目。

segments.en: So in advanced media, we're only going to pick out a couple of words and phrases and just talk about it and talk about the topic in general.
segments.zh: 所以在高级媒体中，我们只会挑选出几个单词和短语，只是谈论它并谈论这个话题。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: So one of the first phrases that we decided to talk about here is this phrase, I failed you because this is really the theme of the letter.
segments.zh: 所以我们决定在这里谈论的第一个短语是这句话，我辜负了你，因为这真的是这封信的主题。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So if you fail someone, it means that you let that person down.
segments.zh: 所以如果你让某人失败，这意味着你让那个人失望了。

segments.en: Okay, so you fail someone, I failed you, or you can say, he failed me.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以你让某人失败了，我辜负了你，或者你可以说，他让我失望了。

segments.en: So when I really needed that person the most, that person didn't come through or let me down or failed me.
segments.zh: 所以当我真的最需要那个人的时候，那个人没有通过或让我失望或让我失望。

segments.en: All right, so let's give an example maybe.
segments.zh: 好吧，让我们举个例子吧。

segments.en: I needed my brother to pick me up because I don't have a car.
segments.zh: 我需要我的兄弟来接我，因为我没有车。

segments.en: And my brother was supposed to pick me up at four o'clock and he forgot.
segments.zh: 我哥哥应该在四点钟来接我，他忘记了。

segments.en: He didn't come.
segments.zh: 他没有来。

segments.en: He really failed me.
segments.zh: 他真的让我失望了。

segments.en: All right, he failed you.
segments.zh: 好吧，他让你失望了。

segments.en: Yeah, I was disappointed.
segments.zh: 是的，我很失望。

segments.en: Well, this isn't that's not as serious as what happened here in this letter, I think.
segments.zh: 好吧，我认为这并不像这封信中发生的那么严重。

segments.en: Right?
segments.zh: 对吧？

segments.en: I think so.
segments.zh: 我想是的。

segments.en: But we could talk about what did happen.
segments.zh: 但我们可以谈谈发生了什么。

segments.en: I think I have a theory.
segments.zh: 我想我有一个理论。

segments.en: And I know you have a theory.
segments.zh: 我知道你有一个理论。

segments.en: So we can talk about that in a minute.
segments.zh: 所以我们可以在一分钟内讨论这个问题。

segments.en: But before that, we have some other phrases about forgiveness and disappointment.
segments.zh: 但在此之前，我们还有一些关于宽恕和失望的短语。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So he also said, you mean the world to me and now I come to you asking for forgiveness.
segments.zh: 所以他也说，你对我来说意味着世界，现在我来找你请求宽恕。

segments.en: Okay, so we've got a positive and a negative.
segments.zh: 好的，所以我们有正面和负面的。

segments.en: So the positive here is you mean the world to me.
segments.zh: 所以这里的积极因素是你对我来说意味着世界。

segments.en: You mean the world to me.
segments.zh: 你对我来说意味着世界。

segments.en: This means you are so important to me.
segments.zh: 这意味着你对我很重要。

segments.en: You're one of the most important people in my life.
segments.zh: 你是我生命中最重要的人之一。

segments.en: You're worth the entire world, in my opinion.
segments.zh: 在我看来，你值得整个世界。

segments.en: Yeah, it's a very poetic way of saying you're very important.
segments.zh: 是的，这是一种非常富有诗意的方式来表达你非常重要。

segments.en: And then he says, and now I come asking for your forgiveness.
segments.zh: 然后他说，现在我来请求你的宽恕。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So this implies that he did something wrong.
segments.zh: 所以这意味着他做错了什么。

segments.en: I come asking for forgiveness.
segments.zh: 我来请求宽恕。

segments.en: So in English, we ask for forgiveness.
segments.zh: 所以在英语中，我们请求宽恕。

segments.en: You can also beg for forgiveness.
segments.zh: 你也可以乞求宽恕。

segments.en: So please, please forgive me.
segments.zh: 所以请原谅我。

segments.en: But you can't demand forgiveness.
segments.zh: 但你不能要求宽恕。

segments.en: I demand you forgive.
segments.zh: 我请求你原谅。

segments.en: No, that doesn't quite work.
segments.zh: 不，这不太有效。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: What else do we have?
segments.zh: 我们还有什么？

segments.en: We've got the world again here.
segments.zh: 我们在这里再次拥有世界。

segments.en: He says he, the guy who's reading, he says, you know, I wanted to be the comfort for your soul.
segments.zh: 他说他，那个正在阅读的人，他说，你知道，我想成为你灵魂的安慰。

segments.en: So this is very, again, poetic, when the world was too much to handle.
segments.zh: 因此，当世界无法处理时，这非常，再次，诗意。

segments.en: Too much to handle is a really important English phrase.
segments.zh: 太多无法处理是一个非常重要的英语短语。

segments.en: And I'm sure you've heard it before, but we could talk about a little bit here.
segments.zh: 我相信你以前听过，但我们可以在这里谈谈。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So he says when everything else was too much to handle.
segments.zh: 所以他说当其他一切都无法处理的时候。

segments.en: So everything was so difficult or it was overwhelming.
segments.zh: 所以一切都很困难，或者是压倒性的。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So you could say even in the office, man, all this work I have to do, it's too much to handle.
segments.zh: 所以你可以说，即使在办公室里，伙计，我必须做的所有这些工作，都无法处理。

segments.en: Right, right.
segments.zh: 对，对。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Too much to handle.
segments.zh: 太多了，无法处理。

segments.en: You could also say a child is too much to handle.
segments.zh: 你也可以说一个孩子太多了，无法处理。

segments.en: I think they said this about my brother.
segments.zh: 我想他们是说我哥哥的。

segments.en: He was very difficult growing up.
segments.zh: 他长大后非常困难。

segments.en: Too hard.

segments.en: He's too, he's too difficult to handle.
segments.zh: 他也是，他太难处理了。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Well, what about in the part where he says you place comfort where there was fear, confidence where there was doubt.
segments.zh: 好吧，在他说你把安慰放在有恐惧的地方，有信心的地方有信心的地方怎么样。

segments.en: So this structure is interesting because you placed something where there used to be something else.
segments.zh: 所以这个结构很有趣，因为你把一些东西放在曾经有别的东西的地方。

segments.en: So you're replacing something, you're changing something for something else.
segments.zh: 所以你正在替换一些东西，你正在为其他东西改变一些东西。

segments.en: It's an exchange.
segments.zh: 这是一个交换。

segments.en: So you could say you placed comfort where there was fear, you placed happiness, where there was sadness.
segments.zh: 所以你可以说你把安慰放在了有恐惧的地方，你把幸福放在了有悲伤的地方。

segments.en: Where there was sadness.
segments.zh: 哪里有悲伤。

segments.en: So it's always like kind of opposites, right?
segments.zh: 所以它总是像对立面一样，对吧？

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Light where there was dark.
segments.zh: 有黑暗的地方的光。

segments.en: Right, exactly.
segments.zh: 对，没错。

segments.en: So that's an interesting format of saying something.
segments.zh: 所以这是一种有趣的表达方式。

segments.en: You did something where there used to be something else.
segments.zh: 你做了一些曾经有别的事情的事情。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: And what about this word to jeopardize?
segments.zh: 那么要危及的这个词呢？

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: This is a good one.
segments.zh: 这是一件好事。

segments.en: I always think of the TV game show Jeopardy, but that's a noun.
segments.zh: 我总是想到电视游戏节目的危险，但这是一个名词。

segments.en: This here is a verb to jeopardize and that means to put something in danger or to risk losing something.
segments.zh: 这是一个用于危及的动词，这意味着将某事置于危险之中或冒险失去某些东西。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So to jeopardize your health if you're doing something dangerous.
segments.zh: 因此，如果您正在做危险的事情，请危及您的健康。

segments.en: So smoking jeopardizes one's health.
segments.zh: 所以吸烟会危及一个人的健康。

segments.en: You're putting your health at risk.
segments.zh: 你把你的健康置于危险之中。

segments.en: Or I don't want to jeopardize my savings by investing everything I have in stocks.
segments.zh: 或者我不想通过将我拥有的所有东西投资于股票来危及我的储蓄。

segments.en: That means I would prefer to do something safer.
segments.zh: 这意味着我更愿意做一些更安全的事情。

segments.en: So you don't like to jeopardize your well-being.
segments.zh: 所以你不喜欢危及你的幸福。

segments.en: I like to play it safe, as we say.
segments.zh: 正如我们所说，我喜欢安全地玩它。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Very good.
segments.zh: 很好。

segments.zh: 当他说只是足够了是什么意思？

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: This is very romantic, intensely romantic.
segments.zh: 这是非常浪漫的，非常浪漫的。

segments.zh: 他说，即使我们相距甚远，只是存在，所以只是存在，只是呼吸就足够了。

segments.en: So just knowing that she's in the world was enough for him to feel happy.
segments.zh: 所以只要知道她在这个世界上就足以让他感到快乐。

segments.en: So that's what he means with just being was enough.
segments.zh: 所以这就是他对仅仅存在就足够的意思。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So just being is existing.
segments.zh: 所以只是存在。

segments.en: It's being alive.
segments.zh: 它还活着。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Very good.
segments.zh: 很好。

segments.zh: 我想我们应该再听一次道歉信，我们会回来的。

segments.zh: 唯一的问题是，为了让你留在我生命里，我愿意拿一切去冒险。

segments.en: All the things that I told you about how I felt and how you make me feel were true.
segments.zh: 我告诉你的所有关于我的感受以及你让我感觉如何的事情都是真实的。

segments.en: Nothing else mattered to me except hearing the laughter in your voice when you were happy.
segments.zh: 除了听到你开心时的笑声，其他一切对我都不重要。

segments.en: You made my days easy to get through and my nights peaceful.
segments.zh: 你让我的日子很容易度过，我的夜晚很平静。

segments.en: You helped me look forward to another day.
segments.zh: 你帮助我期待了另一天。

segments.en: Even though distance separated us, just being was enough.
segments.zh: 尽管我们相隔遥远，只要有这份陪伴就已足够。

segments.en: I'm sorry for hurting you and if I had to do it all over again, I would have been 100% with you.
segments.zh: 对不起，我伤害了你。如果能重新来过，我一定会对你百分之百坦诚。

segments.en: Forgive me please.
segments.zh: 请原谅我。

segments.en: Alright so what do you think he did that he's apologizing in this way?
segments.zh: 好吧，那么你认为他做了什么，他以这种方式道歉？

segments.en: Because I don't think there were a couple right?
segments.zh: 因为我不认为有一对吧？

segments.en: Because he mentions friendship a couple of times.
segments.zh: 因为他多次提到友谊。

segments.en: Yes with a but.
segments.zh: 是的，但是。

segments.en: You don't write a letter like this to someone who you want to stay friends with.
segments.zh: 你不会给你想成为朋友的人写这样的信。

segments.en: You write a letter to this to someone who you have some kind of romantic or intense feeling for right?
segments.zh: 你给你写了一封信给你有某种浪漫或强烈的感觉的人，对吧？

segments.en: So to me this seems like a letter that was written to someone who was a great friend and he's afraid of losing that because he cares even more for her.
segments.zh: 所以对我来说，这似乎是一封写给好朋友的人的信，他害怕失去这封信，因为他更关心她。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: But yeah I guess but do you think he's confessing his love in a certain way here?
segments.zh: 但是，是的，我想，但你认为他在这里以某种方式承认他的爱吗？

segments.en: I think in some ways he's confessing a love.
segments.zh: 我认为在某些方面他是在承认爱情。

segments.en: You can love your friends that's okay.
segments.zh: 你可以爱你的朋友，这没关系。

segments.en: But more than that he's just he's apologizing for something that he thinks has completely destroyed their friendship.
segments.zh: 但更重要的是，他只是在为他认为完全摧毁了他们友谊的东西道歉。

segments.en: And that is where I'm very confused because I have no idea what he did.
segments.zh: 这就是我很困惑的地方，因为我不知道他做了什么。

segments.en: Well maybe he did something that let her down.
segments.zh: 好吧，也许他做了一些让她失望的事情。

segments.en: Maybe he became jealous of her new boyfriend or something like that.
segments.zh: 也许他嫉妒她的新男友或类似的东西。

segments.en: Yeah or maybe it's something catty like he was supposed to do something with her and ended up doing something with other people and left her out or embarrassed her in front of people.
segments.zh: 是的，或者也许这是一些像他应该和她一起做点什么并最终与其他人做某事的东西，把她排除在外或在人们面前尴尬的事情。

segments.en: It's hard to say.
segments.zh: 很难说。

segments.en: Now have you ever written an apology letter?
segments.zh: 现在你写过道歉信吗？

segments.en: Yeah I have.
segments.zh: 是的，我有。

segments.en: I've written a few apology letters.
segments.zh: 我写了几封道歉信。

segments.en: I have a very strong sense of guilt.
segments.zh: 我有一种非常强烈的内疚感。

segments.en: I was raised Catholic.
segments.zh: 我是天主教徒。

segments.en: So an apology letter.
segments.zh: 所以一封道歉信。

segments.en: Is it do you usually plan out what you want to say or you just like you just splurge your feelings onto the paper?
segments.zh: 是你通常计划你想说什么，还是你只是把你的感受挥霍到纸上？

segments.en: Well you know me.
segments.zh: 好吧，你认识我。

segments.en: My personality is very planned and organized and so normally I have points.
segments.zh: 我的个性非常有计划和有条理，所以通常我有观点。

segments.en: So I say if this is the problem there's three parts.
segments.zh: 所以我说如果这是问题，有三个部分。

segments.en: I have an answer for each part and the very end I have the heartfelt apology.
segments.zh: 我对每个部分都有一个答案，最后我有衷心的道歉。

segments.en: Wow.
segments.zh: 哇。

segments.en: It's like an essay.
segments.zh: 这就像一篇论文。

segments.en: I guess it's a little bit more organized.
segments.zh: 我想它更有条理。

segments.en: If I were to write something like this I would just like start writing and whatever comes out.
segments.zh: 如果我要写这样的东西，我只想开始写作和任何结果。

segments.en: That would probably make less sense than your letter.
segments.zh: 这可能不如你的信有意义。

segments.en: Well I just try to stay on focus, stay on point and address the matter at hand because otherwise then you get into other stuff and you can make people more angry.
segments.zh: 好吧，我只是尽量保持专注，保持重点并解决手头的问题，因为否则你会陷入其他事情，你可以让人们更生气。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: But it is really important to write an apology letter.
segments.zh: 但写道歉信真的很重要。

segments.en: Now some of the words and phrases and the vocabulary used here can be used in circumstances that are not only romantic.
segments.zh: 现在，这里使用的一些单词和短语以及词汇可以用于不仅浪漫的环境。

segments.en: You can use it in a professional way as well.
segments.zh: 您也可以以专业的方式使用它。

segments.en: That's true.
segments.zh: 确实如此。

segments.en: In a professional sense you want to be careful not to get too personal.
segments.zh: 在专业意义上，您要小心不要变得过于个人化。

segments.en: So in a professional sense it's good to say that you're sorry for any mix ups or for misunderstandings but in the future you will try to make things better or improve.
segments.zh: 因此，在专业意义上说，您对任何混淆或误解感到抱歉是件好事，但在未来您会尝试让事情变得更好或改进。

segments.en: But in friendships and in families and in romantic relationships apology letters are very very important because I'm a big believer in mending bridges.
segments.zh: 但在友谊和家庭和浪漫关系中，道歉信非常非常重要，因为我非常相信修补桥梁。

segments.en: I know a lot of people who we say in English to burn a bridge that means to destroy a relationship and never go back.
segments.zh: 我认识很多人，我们用英语说他们要烧一座桥，这意味着破坏一段关系，永远不会回去。

segments.en: But I like to mend bridges to make sure that people who I was friends with don't, you know if we have a fight don't just hate me forever.
segments.zh: 但我喜欢修补桥梁，以确保与我成为朋友的人没有，你知道如果我们打架，不要永远恨我。

segments.en: That even if there's a disagreement that they understand my perspective or that I understand theirs.
segments.zh: 即使他们理解我的观点或我理解他们的观点存在分歧。

segments.en: That's true.
segments.zh: 确实如此。

segments.en: I think that's important.
segments.zh: 我认为这很重要。

segments.en: What about apology emails?
segments.zh: 道歉电子邮件呢？

segments.en: Do you agree with those?
segments.zh: 你同意这些吗？

segments.en: I think that they are a necessity of the 21st century.
segments.zh: 我认为它们是 21 世纪的必需品。

segments.en: I mean I live far away from most of my friends and family and so it's important for me to be able to communicate in any way.
segments.zh: 我的意思是我远离我的大多数朋友和家人，因此能够以任何方式进行交流对我来说很重要。

segments.en: But and sometimes I mean I'm very shy with some people so sometimes it's hard for me to talk on the phone because I get stuck and then I don't I can't think of what I wanted to say.
segments.zh: 但是有时我的意思是我对某些人很害羞，所以有时我很难通过电话交谈，因为我被卡住了，然后我没有想到我想说什么。

segments.en: And so if a letter helps in that way to get you past your fear or your anxiety then by all means an email is just as much.
segments.zh: 因此，如果一封信以这种方式帮助您摆脱恐惧或焦虑，那么无论如何，一封电子邮件同样多。

segments.en: I actually received a letter, a handwritten letter through an email.
segments.zh: 我实际上通过电子邮件收到了一封信，一封手写的信。

segments.en: How did that happen?
segments.zh: 这是怎么发生的？

segments.en: So the person, they scanned it, they scanned the letter.
segments.zh: 所以那个人，他们扫描了它，他们扫描了这封信。

segments.en: Oh wow.
segments.zh: 哦，哇。

segments.en: So it was still like it still had a very intimate and personal sense.
segments.zh: 所以它仍然像它仍然具有非常亲密和个人的感觉。

segments.en: But obviously since the mail takes so long and everything they just scanned it and then they sent it to my email.
segments.zh: 但显然，由于邮件需要很长时间，并且他们只是扫描了它，然后他们将其发送到我的电子邮件中。

segments.en: That's nice.
segments.zh: 真不错。

segments.en: So I think that's a good idea.
segments.zh: 所以我认为这是个好主意。

segments.en: Maybe you could try that one.
segments.zh: 也许你可以试试那个。

segments.en: I'll try that one.
segments.zh: 我会试试那个。

segments.en: I don't agree with the one line email.
segments.zh: 我不同意一线电子邮件。

segments.en: I'm sorry, forgive me.
segments.zh: 对不起，原谅我。

segments.en: Yeah, yeah, that's not good.
segments.zh: 是的，是的，这不好。

segments.en: As my parents always used to say when I was growing up and I'd get in fights with my little brother, the only apologies that we accept are the ones that are from the heart.
segments.zh: 正如我的父母常说的，我长大后会和我的小弟弟吵架，我们唯一接受的道歉是发自内心的。

segments.en: So I used to have to apologize again and again and again until I actually meant it.
segments.zh: 所以我曾经不得不一次又一次地道歉，直到我真正的意思。

segments.en: And so I think that this is a very true kind of idea that, well maybe not in business and work where you have to be cordial, but with friends and real relationships with people who you care about, obviously real apologies are very important.
segments.zh: 所以我认为这是一种非常真实的想法，也许不是在你必须亲切的商业和工作中，而是与朋友和与你关心的人的真实关系，显然真正的道歉是非常重要的。

segments.en: Of course.
segments.zh: 当然。

segments.en: So this is an interesting topic and we recommend that if you have any other questions or doubts or maybe you want some other explanation for this letter, you can come to EnglishPod.com, leave it in the comment section and we'll be there.
segments.zh: 所以这是一个有趣的话题，我们建议如果您有任何其他问题或疑问，或者您可能想要对这封信进行一些其他解释，您可以访问 englishpod.com，将其留在评论部分，我们会在那里。

segments.en: So until next time.
segments.zh: 那么，下次见。

segments.en: Bye.
segments.zh: 再见。
